source_visual_observations: Parallel horizontal AB and CD joined by the zigzag B-E-D; angle B=20°, angle D=60°.
audit.independent_solution: EB makes20° above the rightward horizontal, and ED makes60° below it because AB is parallel to CD. Therefore BED=20+60=80°, choice B.
